turning_control.status: Four feedback gains trained by seeded CEM in MuJoCo; independent holdouts/native validation pending
turning_control.basis: Finite steering of the twelve existing bogie yaw joints plus two coupler yaw joints. Initial geometry uses symmetric 21 m half-spacing and zero extension. Radius/angle relation is a kinematic command approximation, not a handling rating. Speed and curvature commands are limited together; native force/torque constraints still determine actual motion. Actual lateral acceleration and trailer response require separate measurement. The nominal path request uses a 25 degree equivalent joint angle, leaving correction authority up to the 28 degree operating target and 30 degree mechanical stop.

contact.contact_geometry_revision: r019 measured cleat envelope; original nominal 0.04 m compliant contact retained

hydraulics.scope: Custom hydraulic design assumptions: adiabatic gas, incompressible oil, quasi-static lines, metering loss, finite relief pressure, shared finite oil inventory and powered leveling. No production cylinder, thermal/hose-transient or fatigue qualification.

track_tension.scope: Elastic taut-disc convex envelope, finite passive recoil, actual +X sliding idler per belt. Wheel-supported terrain contacts remain reduced. No chain pin, free-span terrain contact, derailment or rated recoil hardware. 12000 kg per new moving idler is provisional, using the existing road-wheel effective-mass class; prior frame masses retained, so total mass rises 288000 kg and is not a CAD-derived allocation.

access.basis: Provisional six-door mechanism and finite drive inputs. Adds 480 kg to the previous lumped carrier; no complete CAD mass ledger, rated hardware or safety qualification.

interior.scope: Actual floor/fixtures and partitioned hollow wall/window contacts. Door bodies use separate moving leaf/handle proxies. Hinge mating is represented by the scalar joint, not detailed bearing surface contacts.

equipment.scope: Finite-force named rigid-body mechanisms. Hydraulic/rope skins follow actual physical endpoints; cylinder skin mass lumped on luff. Provisional 30 mm steel / 20 mm aluminium thin-wall envelope masses deaggregated from provisional hull allocation. No manufacturer ratings.

config.status: r015 independent suspension candidate; untrained, not installed
config.basis: Provisional mass allocation retains 10,000 tonne simulation total, subtracting actual candidate connector, bogie and road-wheel body masses from the two hull masses. Body masses/inertias and actuator ratings remain design estimates. Native independent heave/yaw/pitch/roll and 48 sprung road-wheel coordinates; terrain contact reduced to compliant belt patches, no deformable soil or per-link inertia claim.

articulation.status: r015 candidate; not yet deployed or trained
articulation.coordinates: SI; X forward, Y left, Z up
articulation.basis: Latest user steering supersedes the earlier +/-45 degree target: reduce the maximum articulation and add modular cargo trailers with four cranes per transport module. Candidate mechanical yaw limits are now +/-30 degrees, with tighter speed-dependent operation still to implement. Earlier 45-degree geometry/fixture and suite_v1 straight-ground evidence are historical and retained with their original configuration. Recheck clearances for added cranes, interchangeable cargo and an additional powered module; the 4 m extension is retained as available travel pending a smaller required-stroke assessment. Masses, actuator limits and terrain articulation ranges are design assumptions, not hardware ratings. Bearing axes remain yaw at reference anchor, pitch 2.2 m aft, roll 0.9 m aft of pitch.
articulation.deployment_condition: New native joint geometry, finite actuator controls, collision sweeps and cross-engine tests must pass before promotion; original r014 remains installed.
articulation.extension_policy_basis: The four-crane two-hull candidate passes 333 discrete offset-axis surface screens at 0 to 4 m extension and +/-30 deg yaw with sampled pitch/roll. Retraction (0 m) already passes the sampled nominal-suspension poses, so transport defaults to retracted. This does not certify continuous, suspended, three-module or deployed-crane clearance; mechanical locking remains to implement.
